epic.title: Setup Revamp - Prompt-Pool Quota and New-Analysis Wizard
epic.jiraSummary: EPIC-045: Setup Revamp - Prompt-Pool Quota and New-Analysis Wizard
epic.functionalNeed:
This epic rebuilds the new-analysis wizard around a prompt pool. Today coverage is sold as a fixed per-brand, per-country and per-category unit, so cost grows with every client and agencies onboard only their largest accounts, and the Prompts step never shows what a selection will consume. Sales feedback and the pricing signals ask for the same things: multi-brand packaging, a simpler meter and no per-engine pricing. With this epic, prompts are the only meter, never engines: brands, categories, countries and languages are unlimited, and one pool is shared by every analysis of the organisation. A prompt costs one slot per market.

The wizard has four steps: Brand & Country, Categories, Prompts and Review. It opens from the New Analysis button of the GEO dashboard, straight on Brand & Country. The sidebar stepper names each step and carries Back to Dashboard, the footer keeps Back and the primary action fixed, and everything above the footer scrolls. Everything set during creation stays manageable after launch in Manage Scope.

The unbranded analysis and the Other fallback for unclassified prompts are in EPIC-035. It adds an Analysis Type step before Brand & Country and builds on this wizard and this pool, so this epic ships first. Until EPIC-035 ships, every prompt has a category and a question type.
dependencies: EPIC-002 (GEO-104) and EPIC-006 (GEO-100): this wizard replaces the EPIC-002 wizard, and the pool replaces the per-type quotas, Countries and Categories max that the wizard and Manage Scope enforce today.
EPIC-029 (GEO-680): story 1.12 adds the Prompt pool field next to its user quota in the back office.
EPIC-023 (GEO-656, shipped): the Language for AI Insights on Brand & Country stays as it works today.
EPIC-045 (GEO-1069): the brand website asked for a custom brand applies on Brand & Country.
notes: Updated 2026-10-09: over the pool, the wizard blocks only the launch; adding and ticking prompts stay possible so the user can assemble every prompt, then untick down to the pool (story 1.7). Criteria marked (Updated 2026-10-09) changed.

Updated 2026-10-20: competitors are resolved in the background when a market and category has no usable Visibility answer (story 1.4, delivered by STORY-45.13 / GEO-1251); in Manage Scope, a pool with no free slot disables Add prompt, Add country and Add category up front (story 1.10). Criteria marked (Updated 2026-10-20) changed.

This epic is the product side of the prompt-based pricing initiative (pricing v0.3). Plan names and price points are set outside the product, and engine access per plan is the upgrade lever. The functional rules come from the GEO flexible scope behaviour spec (rule IDs such as S3.12 are quoted where useful). The design is the Figma page "Onboarding / New Analysis V3" of the Measure - GEO Module file: https://www.figma.com/design/xctSRqtM653zRS7QY3KMm0/Measure---GEO-Module?node-id=13458-101707

Every UI string of this epic, with its key and its en-US, en-GB, fr-FR and es-ES text, is in the strings sheet, together with the glossary and the quota keys to remove. The criteria quote the English text only: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1G3C6DF1B_GmOrga4BB9GYtxv1fc-x7mCsnxyVsumL8Y/edit

stories.title: Share one prompt pool across all analyses

userStory.want: to spend one prompt quota across any brand, category, country or language
userStory.so: each additional client becomes cheaper to onboard instead of costing a new fixed unit

acceptanceCriteria.title: One pool, no structural cap
acceptanceCriteria.when: I keep prompts in any analysis
acceptanceCriteria.then: the balance decreases and no per-brand, per-category, per-country or per-language cap blocks me

acceptanceCriteria.title: One slot per market, unticked costs nothing
acceptanceCriteria.then: it consumes two slots; an unticked prompt consumes none

acceptanceCriteria.title: Deleting an analysis frees its slots
acceptanceCriteria.then: its slots return to the pool immediately

acceptanceCriteria.title: Downgrade never touches what exists
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pool is reduced by a downgrade or a non-renewal
acceptanceCriteria.then: existing prompts and running analyses are untouched and only adding prompts is blocked until the count fits

acceptanceCriteria.title: Filter by country, languages roll up
acceptanceCriteria.given: an analysis with several country and language pairs
acceptanceCriteria.then: I filter by country and its languages roll up together

stories.title: Set the brand and the markets

userStory.want: to name my brand and add as many markets as I need
userStory.so: the prompts are localised for each country and language

acceptanceCriteria.title: Questions
acceptanceCriteria.then: it asks "What brand are you analyzing?" and "Which countries do you want to analyze?"

acceptanceCriteria.title: Add a country: country first, then language
acceptanceCriteria.then: I pick a country first, and the language select, disabled until then, is prefilled with its primary language and lists its other languages

acceptanceCriteria.title: Change a market's language, no limit
acceptanceCriteria.then: it applies, and one country in two languages means two market rows, with no limit on markets

acceptanceCriteria.title: Language for AI Insights
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Language for AI Insights below the markets applies to this analysis's insights and summaries only

acceptanceCriteria.title: Empty brand
acceptanceCriteria.then: the field shows a red border and a message naming it, such as "Add your brand to continue."

acceptanceCriteria.title: Discovery loading screen
acceptanceCriteria.then: a loading screen states that category discovery takes about 20 seconds

acceptanceCriteria.title: Wizard shell (epic intro, applies to every step)
acceptanceCriteria.given: I click New Analysis on the GEO dashboard
acceptanceCriteria.then: it opens on the first step of the setup (Brand & Country; once the unbranded analysis epic GEO-1209 ships, Analysis Type comes first), the sidebar stepper names each step and carries Back to Dashboard, the footer keeps Back and the primary action fixed, and everything above the footer scrolls

userStory.want: to keep, add or remove categories with their translations
userStory.so: the analysis covers the areas I care about

acceptanceCriteria.title: Detected categories with badge and translations; empty state
acceptanceCriteria.when: categories are detected from the brand
acceptanceCriteria.then: each shows an AI-generated badge and its translation per market language; with none, an empty state invites me to add one

acceptanceCriteria.title: Add category modal with editable translations
acceptanceCriteria.then: I enter a name and review an editable translation per market

acceptanceCriteria.title: Removing a category with prompts states the impact
acceptanceCriteria.given: I remove a category that holds prompts
acceptanceCriteria.then: a confirmation states how many prompts across my markets are deleted with it, kept suggestions included

acceptanceCriteria.title: No limit
acceptanceCriteria.then: no limit applies

userStory.as: a user on the Prompts step
userStory.want: a full set of suggested prompts already ticked
userStory.so: I start from a complete analysis and trim it to fit my pool

acceptanceCriteria.title: 10 per type per category per market, all ticked
acceptanceCriteria.then: each category in each market gets 10 prompts per question type, all ticked, each carrying the category and type that produced it

acceptanceCriteria.title: Competitors resolved in the background
acceptanceCriteria.then: a background call resolves the top competitors, invisible to the user, since the wizard has no competitor step
acceptanceCriteria.note: → **delivered by STORY-45.13 (GEO-1251)** — resolved when the analysis runs, not during setup (PM comment, 2026-10-09). Kept here verbatim until the epic is reworded; nothing to build or test for it in this story.

acceptanceCriteria.title: 10 Brand Image prompts per market
acceptanceCriteria.then: each market also gets 10 Brand Image prompts, so 2 markets with 3 categories give 2 x (10 + 3 x 30) = 200 prompts

acceptanceCriteria.title: Over-pool state on arrival
acceptanceCriteria.given: the suggestions exceed the free pool
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is in the over-pool state and I untick prompts until the count fits

acceptanceCriteria.title: Re-ticking a muted row
acceptanceCriteria.when: I tick it again and the pool has room
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is kept again without being regenerated

acceptanceCriteria.title: Trash deletes, untick mutes
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is deleted, which is not the same as unticking

acceptanceCriteria.title: Coming back from Categories keeps my work
acceptanceCriteria.given: I go back to Categories and add a category
acceptanceCriteria.then: my ticked and unticked states, my edits and my custom prompts are kept, and only the new category gets its suggestions, 10 per type per market, all ticked

userStory.want: to add my own prompt directly in the table
userStory.so: I can cover a question the generator did not produce without leaving the step

acceptanceCriteria.title: Editable row at the top
acceptanceCriteria.then: an editable row opens at the top with a text input, category, type and market selects, and confirm and cancel

acceptanceCriteria.title: Selects limited to the analysis
acceptanceCriteria.then: the category select lists only the analysis categories, with no Add category action (a category is added on Categories through Back), and the market select lists only the analysis markets, prefilled from context

acceptanceCriteria.title: No inference, confirm gated
acceptanceCriteria.then: nothing suggests or infers its category or type, and confirm stays disabled until both are picked

acceptanceCriteria.title: Added row: kept, highlighted, CUSTOM
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is kept, highlighted, and marked with a CUSTOM badge

stories.title: Sort, filter and edit the prompt table

userStory.want: to sort and filter the table by column
userStory.so: I can find and fix prompts quickly

acceptanceCriteria.title: Columns
acceptanceCriteria.then: it shows the columns Prompt, Category, Type, Market and Actions

acceptanceCriteria.title: Category and type on every row
acceptanceCriteria.when: I look at the type badges
acceptanceCriteria.then: each prompt shows its category and one of Visibility, Competitive, Reputation or Brand Image

acceptanceCriteria.title: Header menus
acceptanceCriteria.given: the Category, Type or Market header
acceptanceCriteria.then: a menu offers Sort ascending, Sort descending, a checkbox list of values with live counts and Clear filter, and the header then counts the controls applied

acceptanceCriteria.title: No results
acceptanceCriteria.then: a no-results card names the filters in conflict with Clear all filters, and launch stays enabled

acceptanceCriteria.title: Empty table
acceptanceCriteria.then: the filters and the pool tracker stay, and an empty-state card carries its own Add prompt

acceptanceCriteria.title: Pinned tracker and header
acceptanceCriteria.when: the pool tracker line reaches the top
acceptanceCriteria.then: it and the table header stay pinned and only the body scrolls

acceptanceCriteria.title: Edit wording only
acceptanceCriteria.then: only the wording changes; category and type change only through the row selects

acceptanceCriteria.title: Show prompts
acceptanceCriteria.when: I open its Show prompts menu
acceptanceCriteria.then: I can show All, Selected only or Unselected only, and the selected count stays in view

stories.title: Track the pool while selecting prompts

userStory.want: to see the pool balance at all times
userStory.so: I never commit an analysis that overspends my quota

acceptanceCriteria.title: Ring and popover
acceptanceCriteria.then: the toolbar ring reads the slots used after creation over the pool, such as 138 / 150, and its popover splits other analyses, this analysis and free slots

acceptanceCriteria.title: Exactly at the limit
acceptanceCriteria.given: the selection is exactly at the limit
acceptanceCriteria.then: the ring turns amber with a short message and launch stays enabled

acceptanceCriteria.title: Over the limit (Updated 2026-10-09)
acceptanceCriteria.given: the selection is over the limit
acceptanceCriteria.then: the ring turns red, the message states how many prompts are over, and Review & Launch is blocked until the count fits, while adding and ticking prompts stay possible so I can assemble every prompt, then untick down to the pool; in Manage Scope, ticking or adding still needs room in the pool

acceptanceCriteria.title: The system never removes a prompt
acceptanceCriteria.when: I look for a way back
acceptanceCriteria.then: the system never removes a prompt: I untick prompts or contact my account manager for a larger pool

stories.title: Review and create the analysis

userStory.as: a user on the Review step
userStory.want: to see the scope and the engines on one screen
userStory.so: I can confirm the analysis before it is created

acceptanceCriteria.title: Scope and engines
acceptanceCriteria.then: I see the scope with its markets and categories, and the AI engines

acceptanceCriteria.title: Dropped scope and missing metrics
acceptanceCriteria.given: a market, a category or a question type has no kept prompt
acceptanceCriteria.then: a warning names it as dropped, or names the metrics the analysis will not produce

acceptanceCriteria.title: Engines allowed for the organisation
acceptanceCriteria.then: the engines allowed for the organisation in the back office are toggles, on by default with at least one on, and the other engines are not shown, as today

acceptanceCriteria.title: Engines are free
acceptanceCriteria.then: engines never consume slots

acceptanceCriteria.title: Over the pool
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pool is over the limit
acceptanceCriteria.then: Create Analysis is disabled

acceptanceCriteria.title: Confirmation
acceptanceCriteria.then: a confirmation states its prompts, markets, categories and engines, the unticked suggestions kept on the analysis, that prompt changes apply at the next run, and View analysis

technicalNotes: Technical Acceptance Criteria (dev context — not for QA)

userStory.as: a user who started a setup
userStory.want: a confirmation before I leave the wizard
userStory.so: I do not lose my choices by mistake

acceptanceCriteria.title: Confirmation on Back to Dashboard
acceptanceCriteria.then: a confirmation states that exiting discards every choice, since there is no save as draft

acceptanceCriteria.title: Cancel keeps everything
acceptanceCriteria.then: I stay on the same step with my choices intact

userStory.as: a user of a running analysis
userStory.want: to manage its prompts in Manage Scope with the same rules as the wizard
userStory.so: I can change coverage without creating a new analysis

acceptanceCriteria.title: Same table, filters and tracker
acceptanceCriteria.then: I see the wizard's table, filters and pool tracker

acceptanceCriteria.title: Suggested Prompts
acceptanceCriteria.then: they show under Suggested Prompts, and ticking one keeps it from the next run if the pool has room

acceptanceCriteria.title: Edit wording from the next run
acceptanceCriteria.then: only the wording changes, from the next run

acceptanceCriteria.title: Delete frees the slot, keeps the history
acceptanceCriteria.then: its slot returns to the pool and its past data points stay in the history

acceptanceCriteria.title: Last prompt of a group can be deleted
acceptanceCriteria.given: the last prompt of a question type, category or market
acceptanceCriteria.then: it is allowed (the minimum of 1 prompt per group from GEO-581 goes away), and a warning names the metrics the analysis will stop producing

acceptanceCriteria.title: Version history
acceptanceCriteria.then: changes are grouped by date with their count and the original and edited wording

acceptanceCriteria.title: Category or type change
acceptanceCriteria.given: I change a prompt's category or type
acceptanceCriteria.then: a category change keeps its history where it was collected, and a type change ends the old series and starts a new one

acceptanceCriteria.title: Add a category or a market
acceptanceCriteria.given: I add a category or a market
acceptanceCriteria.then: fresh suggestions for it join the retained set, with the pool in view

acceptanceCriteria.title: No free slot in the pool
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pool has no free slot, exactly full or over
acceptanceCriteria.when: I open Prompts in Manage Scope
acceptanceCriteria.then: Add prompt, Add country and Add category are disabled and suggestions cannot be ticked, until deleting or unticking prompts frees a slot

stories.title: See the prompt pool on the GEO dashboard

userStory.as: a user on the GEO dashboard
userStory.want: to see how much of my organisation's prompt pool is used
userStory.so: I know before I start a new analysis how much room I have

acceptanceCriteria.title: Pool block
acceptanceCriteria.then: a pool block shows the kept prompts of all analyses over the pool, such as 138 / 150, with the wizard's ring, and hovering it splits used and free

acceptanceCriteria.title: Exactly at the limit
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pool is exactly at the limit
acceptanceCriteria.then: the ring is amber with a short message and New Analysis stays available

acceptanceCriteria.title: Over the limit
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pool is over the limit, for example after a downgrade
acceptanceCriteria.then: the ring is red with how many prompts are over, and a new analysis can be started but not launched until the count fits

acceptanceCriteria.title: Prompts column
acceptanceCriteria.then: a sortable "Prompts" column after Categories shows the pool slots each analysis uses (kept prompts × markets), so the column adds up to the pool block

acceptanceCriteria.title: Counts follow changes
acceptanceCriteria.given: an analysis is deleted or edited
acceptanceCriteria.when: I come back to the dashboard
acceptanceCriteria.then: the counts reflect it

stories.title: Set the prompt pool of an organisation in the back office

userStory.want: to set one prompt pool per organisation and see each organisation's usage in the list
userStory.so: the quota we sell is the quota the product enforces

acceptanceCriteria.title: One field replaces the old quotas
acceptanceCriteria.given: I create or edit an organisation
acceptanceCriteria.then: one "Prompt pool" field replaces the four per-type fields and the "Countries" and "Categories max" fields, while the user quota, collection frequency (Daily or One time) and allowed AI engines stay as today

acceptanceCriteria.title: Whole number ≥ 1, with usage hint
acceptanceCriteria.then: it accepts a whole number of at least 1, with a hint such as "138 of 150 prompts in use."

acceptanceCriteria.title: Lowering below usage warns, never blocks
acceptanceCriteria.given: I lower the pool below usage
acceptanceCriteria.then: a warning states that existing prompts and running analyses are untouched and adding prompts stays blocked until the count fits

acceptanceCriteria.title: Prompts column in the organisations list
acceptanceCriteria.then: a sortable "Prompts" column next to User quota shows prompts in use over the pool, such as 138 / 150, in red when over, and the Frequency column and filter stay

stories.title: Resolve competitors when no Visibility prompt is kept

userStory.as: a user who kept Competitive prompts but no Visibility prompt for a category
userStory.want: the analysis to find the brand's top competitors on its own
userStory.so: my Competitive prompts compare my brand with real competitors instead of running empty

acceptanceCriteria.title: Competitors resolved in the background
acceptanceCriteria.then: a background call resolves the top competitors to use in competitive questions, invisible to the user, since they cannot be determined by visibility questions
acceptanceCriteria.note: (AC2 of User Story 1.4, as reworded in the epic on 2026-10-09)

acceptanceCriteria.title: Competitive prompts run even without Visibility
acceptanceCriteria.given: an analysis where a market and category keep Competitive prompts but no Visibility prompt (or none of its Visibility prompts got an answer)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Competitive prompts of that market and category are sent to the AI engines with up to 5 competitors named in place of the placeholders, and their results appear on the dashboard like any other Competitive result

acceptanceCriteria.title: Visibility still wins when it exists
acceptanceCriteria.given: a market and category whose Visibility answers name competitors
acceptanceCriteria.then: the competitors come from the Visibility answers exactly as today, and no background call is made for that market and category

acceptanceCriteria.title: A failed resolution never fails the analysis
acceptanceCriteria.given: the background call fails or returns nothing usable
acceptanceCriteria.then: the Competitive prompts still run, with the competitor names left out as today, and the analysis completes

acceptanceCriteria.title: An analysis with only Competitive prompts completes
acceptanceCriteria.given: an analysis whose only kept prompts are Competitive (no Visibility, Sentiment or Brand Image prompt anywhere)
acceptanceCriteria.then: it completes with its Competitive results, instead of staying in progress

stories.title: Set the prompt pool of existing organisations from their old quota

userStory.want: every existing organisation to get its prompt pool from the quota it has today
userStory.so: no client is blocked on release day and nobody has to set each organisation by hand

stories.formula: pool = countries x (categories x (Visibility + Competitive + Perception per category) + Brand Image per country)

acceptanceCriteria.title: Pool from the old quota
acceptanceCriteria.given: an existing organisation with no prompt pool
acceptanceCriteria.then: its pool is set with the formula above, from the quota values it has in the back office

acceptanceCriteria.title: Current usage is not taken into account
acceptanceCriteria.given: an organisation that uses fewer prompts than its old quota, or none
acceptanceCriteria.then: the pool is still the full old quota, not the number of prompts in use

acceptanceCriteria.title: Pools already set are not touched
acceptanceCriteria.given: an organisation whose pool was already set by an admin
acceptanceCriteria.then: its pool stays as it is

acceptanceCriteria.title: Deleted organisations are skipped
acceptanceCriteria.then: no pool is set for it

acceptanceCriteria.title: Review list before production
acceptanceCriteria.then: the PM gets the list of production organisations with their name, their old quota values, the computed pool and the prompts they use today, and the organisations still on the default quota (25 countries, 5 categories, 20 prompts per type, so 8,000 prompts) are flagged

acceptanceCriteria.title: Done in 1.3
acceptanceCriteria.given: the old quota values are removed in the release after 1.3
acceptanceCriteria.then: this conversion ships in 1.3, before the old quota values are removed

outOfScope: New organisations: their pool is required at creation (STORY-45.12)
